nodes.text: You can see here that adenovirus is a disease of the youngest (gotta catch all the 100+ genotypes...), while hMPV is a disease of both the youngest AND oldest age groups. Not a coincidence that hMPV is related to RSV, which causes similar patterns of disease. https://t.co/dYIDjUlMy4
